checks.title: Anyone can read table clients
checks.why: The table has no row-level security. Anyone with the public key, which every visitor's browser has, can read every row with one request.

checks.title: Secret key in browser code
checks.why: A service_role key ships to every visitor. It skips every database rule, so anyone can read or change all data.

checks.title: Payment code has no test
checks.why: Nothing checks the code that takes money. A small change can charge people twice or unlock paid features for free.

checks.title: No tests
checks.why: A change can break sign-up or payments and nobody notices until a user does.

checks.title: Crashes go unseen
checks.why: If the app crashes for a user, you won't hear about it.

checks.title: Nothing runs before deploy
checks.why: Nothing checks a change before it goes live.

checks.title: File too big to change safely
checks.why: Dashboard.tsx is 1,324 lines; every edit there can break something unrelated.

checks.title: Type checks off
checks.why: The compiler lets whole classes of crashes through, like using a value that may be missing.

checks.title: No secrets in committed settings
checks.why: Only the public database address and key, which are meant to be public.
